interface.shortDescription: AI security reviewer for GitHub pull requests.
interface.longDescription: Aevral is an AI security reviewer for GitHub pull requests. Reviews look for access control, business logic, injection, XSS, SSRF, path traversal, and LLM-integration flaws, with a suggested fix you apply. This plugin does not review code locally. It walks you through installing the Aevral GitHub App so reviews run server-side. After the App is installed, the next pull request can already be reviewed, including before anyone signs in to the console. Public repositories are free up to 500 reviews per organization per month. Private repositories are free up to 25.
defaultPrompt: Set up Aevral on this repository.
Install the Aevral GitHub App so pull requests get a security review.
Connect Aevral reviews on this repo. Do not review the diff locally.
